content.text: Overview of the University of Southern California The University of Southern California (USC), founded in 1880, is a premier private research university located in Los Angeles, California, USA. As one of the oldest private research universities on the West Coast, USC has grown to encompass over 49,000 students (undergraduate and graduate) and employs more than 4,700 full-time faculty members. The main University Park Campus sits in the heart of Los Angeles, with additional campuses such as the Health Sciences Campus facilitating specialized education and research. USC’s established legacy, comprehensive offerings, and urban setting contribute to its strong reputation in both academic and professional spheres.
